scenes.title: Off to the zoo
scenes.location: A welcoming cream-and-sage zoo gate beside rounded trees and a warm stone path. No readable text is generated on the gate.
scenes.camera: Medium-wide eye-level family shot; gentle rightward tracking with the walking family, no sudden zoom.
beats: Start already in a friendly living pose. Alice holds Mother's right hand with her left hand and Father's left hand with her right hand. The family takes two small grounded steps toward the zoo entrance.
